project.name: polyglot

layers.name: Entry Points & Commands
layers.description: Executable entry points: the API server, seed tooling, and probe utility that bootstrap the application.

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Pure business entities and rules — device, command, session, customer, subscription, billing, bot, knowledge, LLM, plan — with no I/O or framework imports.

layers.name: Use Case Layer
layers.description: Orchestrates single use cases (network command execution, device management, hotspot, bot engine, billing) depending only on domain and ports.

layers.name: Port Layer (Contracts)
layers.description: Go interfaces defining contracts: DeviceDriver, TerminalDeviceDriver, repositories, credential vault, LLM provider, WhatsApp gateway, audit writer.

layers.name: Adapters — ConnectRPC & HTTP & WS
layers.description: Transport adapters: ConnectRPC handlers (auth, device, hotspot, billing, bot, customer), HTTP middleware, WebSocket terminal streaming, MCP tools.

layers.name: Adapters — Persistence & Infra
layers.description: Postgres repositories and models, Redis store, AES credential vault, LLM provider clients (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Groq).

layers.name: Device Drivers
layers.description: Vendor-specific network device drivers: MikroTik RouterOS (API via goros + dual-connection streaming), generic SSH/Telnet (scrapligo), Cisco, Huawei OLT, ZTE OLT, NETCONF, GenieACS, WhatsApp gateway.

layers.name: Platform Definitions
layers.description: Vendor-as-data: YAML platform definitions (prompt patterns, login suffixes, command catalogs) consumed by the generic CLI engine.

layers.name: Core Wiring & Cross-Cutting
layers.description: Application composition root, driver registry, configuration/crypto, audit writer, and shared templates.

layers.name: Shared Utilities (pkg)
layers.description: Reusable generic utilities independent of project domain: retry helper and voucher generator.

layers.name: API Contracts & Generated Code
layers.description: Protocol definitions (protobuf, OpenAPI, MCP tools) and generated ConnectRPC/gRPC/protobuf Go code.

layers.name: Database Migrations
layers.description: SQL schema migrations for devices, bot tables, and SSH port additions.

layers.name: Deployment & Infrastructure
layers.description: Dockerfile, docker-compose manifests, CI workflows, Makefile, and editor/agent configuration.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project docs: architecture, ADRs, system structure, tech stack, MikroTik command reference, and agent instructions.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: NetOps + ISP management backend in Go. Start with README and architecture docs to understand the clean architecture (domain/usecase/port/adapter/driver) and the multi-vendor network automation vision.

tour.title: Architecture Decision Records
tour.description: Key decisions: Gin over Echo (0001), device driver without separate session (0002), MikroTik dual-connection streaming (0003), and generic CLI driver based on scrapligo (0004).

tour.title: Server Entry Point
tour.description: cmd/server/main.go boots the HTTP server. cmd/seed/main.go seeds users, Casbin policies, knowledge, and LLM config; cmd/probe/main.go probes services.

tour.title: Application Composition Root
tour.description: internal/app/app.go wires everything: repositories, vault, LLM providers, driver registry, and all use cases and handlers.

tour.title: Configuration & Security
tour.description: internal/config holds environment config, AES credential encryption (crypto.go), Casbin RBAC model, and the system prompt.

tour.title: Domain Layer
tour.description: Pure business entities: device, command (with operation enums), session, customer, subscription, billing invoice, bot conversation, knowledge, LLM config.

tour.title: Port Layer — Contracts
tour.description: Go interfaces decoupling use cases from implementations: DeviceDriver, TerminalDeviceDriver, StreamingDeviceDriver, repositories, CredentialVault, LLMProvider, WhatsAppGateway, ValidatingDriver.

tour.title: Driver Registry
tour.description: internal/registry maps vendor/transport to concrete drivers and dispatches commands, including dual-connection MikroTik exec/stream handling.

tour.title: MikroTik Driver — RouterOS API (goros)
tour.description: The heart of the project: driver.go (dual-connection exec/stream), connect.go (RouterOS API dial via goros), commands.go (command catalog + Classify/Translate), system.go, ip.go, hotspot, ppp, queue, firewall helpers, and stream.go (output streaming).

tour.title: Generic CLI Engine (SSH/Telnet via scrapligo)
tour.description: genericcli session engine + genericssh/generictelnet drivers use platform YAML + Catalog as vendor-as-data; genericssh also implements TerminalDeviceDriver for interactive PTY sessions (pty.go).

tour.title: Other Device Drivers
tour.description: Cisco, Huawei OLT, ZTE OLT (SNMP/telnet), NETCONF, and GenieACS (TR-069) drivers plus the WhatsApp gateway driver.

tour.title: Network Use Cases
tour.description: ExecuteCommand (with goros Validate gates), GetDeviceStatus, PushConfig, OpenTerminal/StreamTerminal (interactive PTY), GetActiveSessions, StreamOutput.

tour.title: Business & Bot Use Cases
tour.description: Device management CRUD, hotspot operations (voucher, profile, active users), bot engine with guardrails, knowledge retrieval, customer/subscription/billing management.

tour.title: ConnectRPC Handlers (device)
tour.description: The main device handler exposes ConnectRPC services for device CRUD, command execution, status, probe, and terminal streaming (bidi).

tour.title: WebSocket & SSE Streaming
tour.description: WS adapter bridges PTY stdout to browser xterm.js; SSE hub streams command output for live reboot and other long-running ops.

tour.title: MCP Tools & LLM Adapters
tour.description: Model Context Protocol tools (get_device_status, run_command, push_config, knowledge search, Mikhmon) and LLM provider adapters (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Groq).

tour.title: Persistence Layer
tour.description: Postgres repositories + GORM models for devices, users, bot conversations, knowledge, LLM config; Redis cache; AES vault.

tour.title: API Contracts & Migrations
tour.description: Protobuf definitions for ConnectRPC services (auth, device, hotspot, billing, bot, knowledge, probe, rbac, whatsapp) and SQL migrations.

tour.title: Deployment
tour.description: Dockerfile and docker-compose for the backend plus dependencies; CI workflow and Makefile for build/lint/test.
